asset: Belltower ground edge detail atlas v1
kind: original generated albedo cutout; offline candidate
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production albedo cutout texture atlas for small ground details in a realistic Mediterranean hill-town multiplayer map. Make one square 2048 x 2048 RGBA image with real transparency. Arrange exactly FOUR distinct isolated ground-detritus patches in a strict 2 by 2 grid, one centered in each quadrant with generous transparent margins and nothing crossing a cell boundary. Each patch is an irregular horizontal band roughly five times wider than tall, representing about 90 cm long and 18 cm deep of material gathered beside a building at pavement level. Natural muted dusty grey-brown grit and fine earth, a few tiny weathered stone fragments, sparse curled dry oak and olive leaves with believable veins, one or two short thin twigs, occasional very small patches of dull olive moss. Variation: top left mostly dry fine grit; top right grit with sparse dry leaves; bottom left a little moss in the grit; bottom right fine earth, small pebbles and two tiny twigs. All four should feel like restrained incidental buildup, not rubbish piles or grass mats. Photographic fine surface texture and correct small scale. Orthographic straight-down camera, diffuse neutral shadowless albedo lighting, consistent across all four. No directional shadows, no ambient shadow halo, no highlights baked into the material. Extremely irregular broken edges with scattered individual grains and leaf tips into the transparent area. No pavement, no wall, no ground plane or opaque backdrop. No green lawn, bright flowers, litter, text, labels, grid lines, border or watermark. Preserve natural transparency and small interior gaps. This is an unlit material asset, not a landscape scene.
review: Four photographic grit/leaf/moss patches. Actual patches are broader than the requested bands; use their original aspect ratio as sparse pockets, rather than stretching leaves.
